changeSet.author: retail-site-type
retail-site-type
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.retailer_type (tenant_id, code, label, hint, module_key, sort_order, is_active) SELECT NULL, 'RETAIL', 'Retail', 'Shop archetype for gas, liquor, and other retail packs', 'RETAIL', 12, true WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.retailer_type WHERE tenant_id IS NULL AND code = 'RETAIL' ); UPDATE public.retailer_type SET module_key = 'RETAIL' WHERE tenant_id IS NULL AND code IN ('GAS_STATION', 'GAS_STATION_ENT'); UPDATE public.tenant_organization SET retailer_type_code = site_type, site_type = 'RETAIL' WHERE site_type IN ('GAS_STATION', 'GAS_STATION_ENT', 'LIQUOR_STORE', 'DUNKIN_DONUTS', 'SEVEN_ELEVEN') AND (retailer_type_code IS NULL OR retailer_type_code = '');

changeSet.author: retail-site-type
changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.tenant_settings AS settings SET enable_retail_module = true, retail_ai_engine_base_url = CASE WHEN settings.retail_ai_engine_base_url IS NULL OR btrim(settings.retail_ai_engine_base_url) = '' THEN 'http://127.0.0.1:8090' ELSE settings.retail_ai_engine_base_url END FROM public.tenant_organization AS organization WHERE settings.tenant_id = organization.tenant_id AND organization.site_type = 'RETAIL';
